title: Semi-implicit Structure Preserving Method for The Landau-Lifshitz Equation
summary: A critical challenge inherent to the projection method applied to the Landau-Lifshitz equation is the deficiency of rigorous theoretical justifications for the stability of its projection step. To mitigate this limitation, we introduce a semi-implicit numerical scheme, which is formulated on the basis of the first-order Backward Differentiation Formula (BDF) incorporated with one-sided extrapolation and a Crank-Nicolson-type norm-preserving procedure.
